title: Uwell Valyrian 2 Coils - 2 Pack
description: Quad Mesh 0.15ohm These quality coils are designed to be paired with the Uwell Valyrian 2 tank and are best suited for use between 100 and 120 watts. A quad mesh construction guarantees smooth and even heat distribution, which in turn generates huge cloud production and maintains the true flavour profile of your sub ohm e-liquids. Single Mesh 0.32ohm These single mesh coils from Uwell are designed for use with the Valyrian 2 tank and perform best when vaped between 90 and 100 watts. Rated at 0.32ohms, they are ideally partnered with high-VG sub ohm juices and provide a smooth draw with large, loose airflow. Dual Mesh 0.14ohm The 0.14ohm resistance of these Uwell Valyrian 2 coils makes them ideal for use with high-VG sub ohm e-liquids, producing large vapour clouds bursting with intense flavour every single time. Vape between 90 and 100watts for optimum performance with your Valyrian 2 tank.
